result.summary: Found 4 issues on this food delivery home screen, including duplicated restaurant listings, a cut-off card at the screen edge, and minor category filter clipping.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows 'Green Bowl Poké' listed twice with identical images, ratings, delivery time, and price, suggesting a data duplication bug.
issues.suggestion: Verify the backend query/rendering logic to ensure unique restaurant entries are displayed, or replace with distinct restaurant data.

issues.description: The third card 'Smash Bros Bu...' in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen with no visual indication (like a partial peek or scroll hint) that more content is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll indicator or ensure card widths and spacing clearly imply horizontal scrolling is available.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off on the right edge, showing a partial pill/chip, which could look like a rendering error.
issues.suggestion: Add fade-out gradient or partial visibility cue to indicate the row is scrollable, or adjust spacing so it doesn't appear abruptly clipped.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image is white and blends into lighter parts of the food image, reducing visibility.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle background circle or shadow behind the icon to improve contrast against varying image backgrounds.
